basic_details.job_title: SMIMER Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Research Scientist II, Research Scientist I Posts
basic_details.short_information: Two contractual research posts are open in the Multi Disciplinary Research Unit (MRU) of the Surat Municipal Institute of Medical Education & Research (SMIMER), Surat Municipal Corporation: Research Scientist-II (1 post, Rs. 67,000 per month + HRA) and Research Scientist-I (1 post, Rs. 56,000 per month + HRA). The MRU is established under ICMR, Department of Health Research, Government of India, New Delhi. The initial appointment is for eleven (11) months. Applications go to the Dean, SMIMER, by post or in person and must be submitted by 30 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Prepare (A) a Brief Resume, (B) the requisite certificate(s) plus documentary proof(s), and (C) the Application Form duly filled in. The notice prints a separate application form for each post (pages 5 to 8).
Send them by post or in person to: The Dean, D-Block, Surat Municipal Institute of Medical Education & Research (SMIMER), Opp. Bombay Market, Umarwada, Surat-395010, Gujarat.
Super-scribe the envelope as "Application for the post of 'Research Scientist-II'" or "Application for the post of 'Research Scientist-I'".
The notice says the application forms and details regarding the appointment are available on http://smimer.suratmunicipal.gov.in and www.suratmunicipal.gov.in.
The application form carries a check-list of documents. Only self-attested copies are to be submitted, and a self-attested passport size photograph is affixed on the form.
Registration certificate for graduation, post-graduation degree/diploma (if applicable)
Final year mark sheet of qualifying examination
Attempt certificates for graduation, post-graduation degree/diploma (if applicable)
Documentary proof of working in an ICMR/DHR/CSIR/DBT funded research project (if applicable)
NOC from the present employer (if applicable)
important_instructions: Candidates employed in Central Govt./State/Union Territories/Statutory Bodies/Research Organizations etc. should submit their N.O.C. at the time of interview along with the requisite documents. Selected candidates must produce a willingness/acceptance certificate for all terms and conditions issued at the time of appointment and enter the contractual agreement. The appointee is not a regular employee of SMC, Surat and is not entitled to any service benefits. The contract service is not considered continuous service when applying for or being appointed to any other post of SMC, Surat. The appointee works as per the duty assigned by the Nodal Officer, MRU, SMIMER. If the duties and behaviour of an in-service candidate are not found satisfactory, the candidate can be relieved before the contractual period ends without prior notice. An in-service candidate who remains on leave for seven (07) continuous days or more without prior permission of the competent authorities is relieved automatically from the post. An appointee who wishes to end the contract can do so by giving seven (07) days prior notice. SMC, Surat/SMIMER reserves all rights of interpretation of any term or condition. The decision of the Municipal Commissioner, SMC, Surat is final, and the area of jurisdiction is Surat only.

content_sections.heading: About SMIMER
content_sections.text: SMIMER is the Surat Municipal Institute of Medical Education & Research, run by the Surat Municipal Corporation, at Opp. Bombay Market, Umarwada, Surat. Its Multi Disciplinary Research Unit (MRU) is established under the Indian Council of Medical Research and the Department of Health Research, Government of India. The vacancies are as per the sanctioning of ICMR/DHR for the MRU.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for 2 posts in total, one for each designation. It prints no category-wise break-up. *Admissible HRA will be as per SMC norms.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice notes that the age criteria priority shall be as per the DHR-ICMR Guidelines. It prints no age cut-off date and no age relaxation. The educational qualification and experience for each post are given below, exactly in the alternatives the notice lists. Post graduate degree (MD/DNB) in Pathology/Microbiology/Biochemistry/Laboratory Medicine recognized by NMC/MCI, with 05 years R&D/teaching experience in Pathology/Microbiology/Genetics/other relevant life science subjects from a recognized university/teaching/research institution. OR PG Diploma in Pathology/Microbiology recognized by NMC/MCI, with 06 years R&D/teaching experience in Pathology/Biochemistry/Microbiology/Laboratory Sciences/Genetics/other relevant life science subjects from a recognized university/teaching/research institution. OR Second class M.Sc plus Ph.D degree in the relevant subject (e.g. Microbiology/Biochemistry/Biotechnology/Molecular Biology/Genetics/other relevant life science subjects) from a recognized university, plus 08 years R&D/teaching experience in these subjects after M.Sc + Ph.D. from a recognized university/teaching/research institution. OR First Class Master's Degree in the relevant subject (e.g. Microbiology/Biochemistry/Biotechnology/Molecular Biology/Genetics/other relevant life science subjects) from a recognized university, plus 08 years R&D/teaching experience in these subjects after the first class Master's Degree from a recognized university/teaching/research institution. MBBS from any institute recognized by NMC/MCI. OR Second Class M.Sc plus Ph.D degree in the relevant subject (e.g. Microbiology/Biochemistry/Biotechnology/Molecular Biology/Genetics/other relevant life science subjects) from a recognized university/teaching/research institution. OR First Class Master's Degree in the relevant subject (e.g. Microbiology/Biochemistry/Biotechnology/Molecular Biology/Genetics/other relevant life science subjects) from a recognized university/teaching/research institution. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is consolidated and fixed per month: Rs. 67,000/- for Research Scientist-II and Rs. 56,000/- for Research Scientist-I, each plus HRA as per SMC norms. Appointees get no other financial or non-financial benefits, facilities or special allowances except the fixed consolidated emoluments as per ICMR/DHR rules for the establishment of the MRU. Central or state government taxation, as applicable, is deducted at source from the salary. The posts are temporary and purely contractual, with an initial appointment of eleven (11) months as per rules and regulations of the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) and the Department of Health Research (DHR). The employment is for a fixed term and ceases automatically on expiry without notice unless renewed or a reemployment letter is issued. Reemployment can be considered subject to conditions then prevailing, such as sanctioning of budget by ICMR/DHR, and is done only if the candidate's performance is found satisfactory.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SMIMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 post of Research Scientist-II and 1 post of Research Scientist-I in the Multi Disciplinary Research Unit.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the SMIMER Research Scientist posts?
faq.answer: The last date of submission of the application is 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Research Scientist-I at SMIMER?
faq.answer: MBBS from any institute recognized by NMC/MCI, OR Second Class M.Sc plus Ph.D, OR First Class Master's Degree in the relevant subject from a recognized university/teaching/research institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Research Scientist-II at SMIMER?
faq.answer: It is an MD/DNB or PG Diploma recognized by NMC/MCI with 05 or 06 years of R&D/teaching experience respectively, OR a Second class M.Sc plus Ph.D or First Class Master's Degree in the relevant subject with 08 years of experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for SMIMER Research Scientist posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years for Research Scientist-II and 35 years for Research Scientist-I. The notice says the age criteria priority shall be as per the DHR-ICMR Guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of SMIMER Research Scientist-II and Research Scientist-I?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 67,000/- per month for Research Scientist-II and Rs. 56,000/- per month for Research Scientist-I, plus HRA.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the SMIMER salary?
faq.answer: Yes, both posts carry "+ HRA", and the notice says the admissible HRA will be as per SMC norms. No other allowances are given except the fixed consolidated emoluments.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for SMIMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the Brief Resume, certificates with documentary proofs and the duly filled Application Form by post or in person to The Dean, D-Block, SMIMER, Opp. Bombay Market, Umarwada, Surat-395010, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q9. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: The envelope should be super-scribed "Application for the post of 'Research Scientist-II'" or "Application for the post of 'Research Scientist-I'", according to the post applied for.

faq.question: Q10. Are the SMIMER Research Scientist posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are temporary and purely contractual, with an initial appointment of eleven (11) months, and the employment ceases automatically on expiry of the term unless renewed.
